promotion.note: Owner asked on 2026-09-16 to push all completed work live. Vercel promoted by creating a new production build of the same source; it reached Ready and the public alias serves it. The preview candidate is behind Vercel deployment protection (401), so hash verification ran against the production alias.

changes: HMH: every held weapon rendered through the pistol's own Blender path into per-hero lazily fetched weapon pages (shotgun, auto-miner, launcher rig, hash rail, lightning ledger, bear-market burner, forked standard).
HMH: three gated destinations (Liquidity Haven, Litecoin Sanctuary + Scrypt Cache, Liquidation Trap) with timed restocks; objective cap 8.
HMH: railgun lane damage falls off to 35% at maximum range; silver coins count toward the run score (10 per coin before the score multiplier).

HMH: bold pickup / interaction banner (weapons, ammo, grenades, health, nuke, timed power-ups, activated sites, found secrets); physics blood droplets on directional flesh hits and dismemberment (explosive, lane and pellet weapons, hazards); desktop mouse-wheel zoom between 0.7x and 1.1x of the readable default.

Chikun: character regraded to the original sheet (white feathers, crimson crest, glowing mint eyes, black coat with red lining) with 39 clips including idle, steep climb/dive and per-obstacle hit poses.

Chikun: one looping course farmland -> forest -> town -> city -> industrial -> suburbs -> coast -> farmland with no reset of speed, score or difficulty; start-overlay teases for the daily challenge and Ranked rewards; replay evidence v5.
STACKED: three music-reactive backdrop scenes with a section director, board frame and piece halo pulse, bespoke menu / tiles / grouped settings / results.

Portal: redesigned global Scores page (per-game banners, cadence and standing tabs, search, sortable columns, jump to my rank, phone cards); Ranked modal lists the flat fee, settlement gas reserve and quoted total.

Web3 services: /api/session (SIWE session tokens), /api/profile (Neon-backed cross-device profiles), /api/settle (relayed settlement), browser profile-sync client wired into the portal behind HOSTED_PROFILE_SYNC=false; contracts round 2 (quoteEntry, relayer vault, per-game soulbound collections); SETTLEMENT_LIVE remains false and nothing is deployed on chain.
Site/game version 1.7.0; service-worker cache marker lesters-arcade-v52-owner-round.
